clips.title: The story
paras: Stormscale naga guard Mathystra's broken halls along Darkshore's northern coast. Ghost Sabers stalk the ruins of the ancient night elven city, shattered during the Great Sundering ten thousand years ago.

Mathystra once housed high-ranking Highborne nobility on Darkshore's northern coast. When the Well of Eternity collapsed during the Great Sundering, great waves shattered the city, toppled its marble arches, and swept much of its stonework into the sea. The surviving night elves left for smaller woodland villages farther south. Sunken courtyards and cracked foundations remain, battered by the coast.

Stormscale naga guard Mathystra's broken halls, driving away travelers who venture north past the Tower of Althalaxx. Ancient Highborne relics lie half-buried among the flagstones, sand, and seafoam. Young night elves sometimes brave the naga to recover remnants of their heritage, while spectral Ghost Sabers stalk the broken streets.
